profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | PHP, Node.js, AWS | Cloud & AI Integration
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer with a passion for building internal tools, microservices, and AI-enhanced systems that help real teams move faster. For the past seven years, I’ve worked across PHP, Node, React, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and AWS to build products that support operations, marketing, recruiting, and data analytics.

I enjoy 0 to 1 product development, solving ambiguous problems, and collaborating directly with cross-functional teams to translate messy workflows into clean, scalable software. My work includes infrastructure redesigns, microservice architecture, and LLM-powered automations using OpenAI models, Gemini, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.

Recently, I’ve been exploring AI agent orchestration through personal platforms like Engineering-Lab and TimeBookt, where I experiment with multi-agent flows, metadata pipelines, MDX content engines, and AI-assisted scheduling features. I’m also expanding my Python experience through automation and personal tooling.

My goal is simple: build tools that make people more effective, enhance organizational intelligence, and unlock new ways of working with AI at the center.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Lead PHP Developer)
positions.description:
- Led development of 5 core microservice applications for dental practice marketing, using PHP (Symfony, Laravel, Vanilla), Node.js, React, Redux, AWS, Docker, and Twilio.
- Implemented QA program with Playwright, Selenium, Postman, and GitHub Actions, cutting production issues significantly.
- Re-architected infrastructure post-2020 breach: secured database, automated backups, hardened system security.
- Integrated AI models (Gemini, Claude) to deliver client insights and campaign optimization.
- Directed a distributed team of 5+ developers across standups, code reviews, and deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: Symfony Framework · Vanilla JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Amazon ECS · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Amazon CloudWatch · amazon secrets manager · Node.js · React.js · QA Automation · playwright · Selenium · Postman API · Google Gemini · Claude ai

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (PHP Developer)
positions.description:
- Built APIs powering a crypto wallet platform and Visa/Mastercard crypto-linked card.
- Designed responsive web platform using PHP, AWS (ECS, RDS, CodeBuild), and cloudwatch monitoring.
- Managed data queries and peer-reviewed code contributions from a 12-person team.
- Raised more than $25M for the organization through the development of more than 20 APIs for an Online Crypto Wallet Application, producing the inaugural, tangible Visa/Mastercard credit card that could be connected to people's crypto wallet and utilized anywhere
- Executed platform design for the organization's website, confirming that all content was easily-accessible on both computer and mobile platforms and contained optimal content to interface with both ideal and target audience members
- Utilized AWS services, including but not limited to ECS, cloudwatch, RDS, codeBuild, and secrets manager throughout the website development process
- Developed 40+ queries for senior management at their request, managing data and its collection to support necessary objectives and solutions
- Oversaw 100+ peer-reviewed software modifications performed by a 12 person team, maintaining the security of all data and content

The blockchain technology company offers blockchain products such as a Wallet to store digital assets, a Prepaid Card to spend the digital assets, and three soon to be released products and services, which include  a Marketplace to buy goods with the digital assets, a cryptocurrency Exchange Platform to buy, sell and trade digital assets, and a open-source hyper speed DPoS Blockchain.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · NoSQL · Payment Systems Integration · Ethereum · Cloud Monitoring

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
- Performed application and software development for the organization's main reporting application and landing pages with a keen awareness of new developments in technology to enhance the application's value to customers
- Enhanced organizational sales and revenue by 43%, completing API design that was unique to potential and existing online buyers to promote the organization's ability to support their objectives and mission while utilizing MySQL and NoSQL to support database management and application logging
- Implemented PHP unit testing via Selenium and Rollbar, leading quality assurance to determine that each individual component of programs were correct regarding their specific coding
- Supported more than 100 of peer reviews of project modifications that were implemented by the team, acting in an advisory role to recommend the modifications or provide alternate changes to streamline the obtainment of specific objectives

Project: Rapport
Type: Custom CRM. Base PHP site.
Responsibilities: Front End & Back End developer
Description: Building and debugging internal reporting, automation, and API integration software. Handling large amounts of data to optimize the ROI of affiliate marketing.

Project: Auto-Savings
Type: Lead generation. Base PHP site.
Responsibilities: Front End & Back End developer
Description: Create Api integrations, post leads to providers according to mapping requirements. Update front-end Js validations and create back-end validations. Store values into session and save into DB.

Project: Mcgyver (IO System)
Type: Custom CRM, Laravel PHP framework
Responsibilities: Front End & Back End developer.
Description: Create modules, modify and update functionalities.

Technologies: PHP, OOP PHP, Javascript, JQuery, CSS "Bootstrap and Less", JSON & XML manipulation. GitHub version control and remote server control. RDBMS: MySQL. Scrum development. 
Tools: PHP Storm IDE, SQL Pro, MAMP, Pivotal Tracker, Base Camp, Slack, Postman.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · SQL · Test Automation · Performance Optimization

positions.title: Mobile Genius
positions.description: As a Mobile Genius, I help new owners get started and current ones get quick, efficient support — developing strong, positive relationships with Apple. When a customer needs assistance, I quickly assess their situation. Sometimes I take care of customers with advice or a solution on the spot, using your knowledge of current Apple technology to help with iPod, iPhone, and iPad devices. At other times, I refer customers to support team members who get them up and running again. I even provide personal training for new customers, helping them acquire the basic skills they need to get started on photo, video, and music projects. By helping Apple maintain strong relationships with customers, The entire store team benefits from my commitment to providing the best care for customers.

positions.description: Increase regional sales, Expand territory, Hosted weekly events, Develop blends.

positions.title: District Sales Manager
positions.description: Increased Sales in NY, NJ, PA, and MA. Expanded sales to include mass market accounts. Assisted in development of a successful sales training course. Implemented sales Slogans and drafted Brochures. Developed and blended new products.
